rubrics.justification: Description is consistent with a good-quality expanded blastocyst and matches the provided 3AA grading, including thin zona, compact ICM, and cohesive TE. However, it relies partly on the supplied Gardner score and does not note any image-specific limitations.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, diagnosis, sperm parameters, BMI, endometrium, and first-cycle status with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with conclusions generally supported by the case data. Minor overstatement appears in assigning very high implantation odds and inferring endometrial receptivity from thickness alone.

Mostly aligned with standard IVF principles and Gardner grading interpretation. Small deviations include somewhat optimistic implantation estimates and treating 12 mm thickness as definitively ideal/receptive without nuance.
Despite framing as comprehensive, the visible response provides little concrete transfer management or future-cycle planning beyond generic lifestyle comments; actionable next steps are limited.
